rule: Art. 6(1) AIA with Annex I, Sections A and B, and Art. 2(2) AIA, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 (machinery moved to Section B)

sources.pinpoint: Art. 6(1)(a), (b); Annex I, Sections A and B (original lists)
Art. 1(41)(a): Annex I, Section A, point 1 deleted; Art. 1(41)(b): Section B, point 21 (Regulation (EU) 2023/1230) added
Art. 1(40)(b): Art. 113, third paragraph, point (c)(ii); Recital 42

interpretations.text: Where the Art. 6(1) conditions are asserted but the Annex I legislation is not named, the engine keeps the Chapter III obligations (the Section A consequence) and routes the Section question to review.

Art. 2(2) is read literally: for an Art. 6(1) system related to a Section B product only Art. 6(1), Art. 60a and Arts. 102 to 112 apply, so Chapter III obligations and Art. 50 transparency obligations are not attached.
An Art. 5 finding is not suppressed on the literal reading of Art. 2(2); the overlap goes to review.
Where the same system is also listed in Annex III, Art. 2(2) is not applied to the Annex III classification; the overlap goes to review with the Chapter III obligations kept.

cases.facts: The AI system is a safety component of a toy covered by Directive 2009/48/EC (Annex I, Section A, point 2), and the toy requires third-party conformity assessment.

The AI system is a safety component of machinery covered by Regulation (EU) 2023/1230, which Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 placed in Annex I, Section B, point 21; third-party conformity assessment is required.
The AI system is a safety component of a motor vehicle covered by Regulation (EU) 2018/858 (Annex I, Section B, point 18), with third-party type approval.
The machinery safety component also interacts with natural persons. Under Art. 2(2) only Art. 6(1), Art. 60a and Arts. 102 to 112 apply.
The Art. 6(1) conditions are asserted, but the Annex I legislation covering the product is not named.
Machinery safety component, but the product does not require third-party conformity assessment (Art. 6(1)(b) fails).
A vehicle safety component (Section B, point 18) that is also a remote biometric identification system (Annex III, point 1(a)).
A machinery safety component for which an Art. 5(1)(f) practice is asserted.
The profile names Annex I, Section A, point 1 (Directive 2006/42/EC), which Art. 1(41)(a) of Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 deleted.
